title: Azure AI Document Intelligence Pipeline with Approval Routing
description:
Uses Azure AI Document Intelligence (formerly Azure Form Recognizer) to read invoices, contracts and other documents, then applies business rules and routes each document to the right approvers.

  • Prebuilt models: prebuilt-invoice, prebuilt-contract and prebuilt-layout for any other document (text, tables).
  • Fields come back typed (dates, amounts, currency, line items) with a confidence value per field.
  • Validation checks required fields, low confidence, subtotal + tax = total and date order, and marks each document valid, requires_review or invalid.
  • Routing sends doubtful documents to a review step first and invoices to approvers by amount; every result is written to an audit log.
  • An optional webhook starts an approval flow in Power Automate or Azure Logic Apps.
implementationSteps: Create an Azure AI Document Intelligence resource and note its endpoint.
Authenticate with an API key or Microsoft Entra ID (DefaultAzureCredential with the Cognitive Services User role).
Send a local file or a URL to begin_analyze_document with the prebuilt model for the document type and wait for the result.
Map the result to a flat record: typed field values, line items and per-field confidence.
Validate the record: required fields, confidence of at least 0.8, subtotal + tax = total, due date after invoice date.
Route the document: review step if not valid, then approvers by invoice amount or legal review for contracts.
Append the full result to an audit log with a document id.
Optionally post a summary to a Power Automate or Logic Apps HTTP trigger that runs the approval.
Measure extraction accuracy on a labelled sample of your own documents and tune the thresholds.
performance:
Targets, not measured results:

  • At least 95 % of header fields (vendor, invoice number, dates, totals) correct on your own labelled sample.
  • Documents below the confidence threshold or with inconsistent totals always go to a person, so errors are caught before booking.
  • Processing time depends on page count and service load, typically a few seconds per page; run the pipeline from a queue for high volumes.
userExperience: Finance and legal teams get each document as a structured record with a clear status: valid, requires review (with the fields that need a look) or invalid (with the reason). Approvers receive the request in their usual Microsoft 365 tools through Power Automate, and every decision can be traced in the audit log.
